posts.title: The skills that won't deprecate in the AI era
posts.description: While you debate whether AI "truly thinks", the market is already redefining what it expects from you. Stop debating AGI and start investing in the right skills.

posts.title: What Vinext teaches about AI-assisted development
posts.description: Cloudflare rewrote Next.js in a week with AI. Almost all lines were generated, but the "almost" is the most important part of this story.

posts.title: Code is cheap now. So what actually matters?
posts.description: With LLMs generating code faster than ever, the skills that set professionals apart are shifting. Communication, System Design, and Spec Review are the new center of gravity.
